statement: In 4 of 6 books with text a spread ends on an unfinished line or a direct question answered on the next spread ('But Mama says...', 'But where is Mud?', 'Hmm. But how?', an invitation to play together).

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books (Book Dash, South Africa, 2021-2025)

analyst_note: 2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. Best Friends ends its penultimate spread on a question answered after the turn. The wordless book is not counted; its turns are visual (shape transitions).

magicpaper.suggested: Hypothesis for page-based stories: end some pages on a question or an open 'says...' and answer it after the turn.
